evidence: All3 realized fixed-H window rankings agree with forecast native preference; realized later-cohort means prefer parent for41/43. This identifies window/propagation mismatch in these conditional states, not a proven arrival-law error or terminal-bias root cause.
causal_change: Replace only no-arrivals MW terminal with same-stream continuing-arrivals MW terminal.
scored_roster: Exactly every original job born at or before H, including initial waiting and committed jobs; H-after births compete in FIFO/MW but are unscored.
cost: Reuse exact common_area through H; add full completion-minus-H residuals for the fixed H population under native MW with continuing background.
recovery: Use server root/sample caches: terminal_state.waiting_ids, lane_ends, counts and population.jobs. Reset start/completion only for H-waiting IDs mutated by the former drain. Preserve all other committed completions and independent reserved lane ends.
arrival_stream: Regenerate original LazyBackgroundArrivals from original rates/window/global sample seed through H and reproduce cached events/work. Continue that RNG stream after H; prefix plus all background events share cap128.
stop_rule: Stop once all H-waiting jobs have been admitted; their full completion offsets are then known, including completions after the final dispatch.
overflow: Keep every original root/sample and partial cost/work. Environmental cap overflow makes its full score unavailable; never drop, resample or raise cap.
controller: Native exact MaxWeight ratios/ties/FIFO and lane/idle clocks; no additional finite controller proposals before or after H.
execution: Reuse all48 completed native-H windows and their unchanged original BG risk membership/physical feasibility; compute only cheap terminal branches on server.
promotion: Offline ranking diagnostic first; subsequent full development mean/tail gates required before policy promotion.
